summary.text: Ashanti Martínez is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 22, appointed in early 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Martínez graduated from Parkdale High School in 2014 and earned a bachelor's degree in political science and government from Howard University in 2018.
His career experience includes working as a county council communications specialist for Prince George's County, a research and policy analyst with CASA, and campaign manager for Vivian Flowers.
He was appointed to the House of Delegates on February 10, 2023, to replace Alonzo Washington, and assumed office on February 24, 2023.
